citations.description: Ticket comment: 'REBAR REVIEW-PLAN RAN GREEN AGAINST REAL BEDROCK' — records commit 17a21ed21, change 1043, Verified +1 and LLM-Review +1 (patchset 1)

Ticket comment: 'CI BLOCKER, and it is NOT this change: change 1043 patchset 2 got Verified -1 twice (deterministic, not a flake)... Root cause filed and fixed as bug 9f0b-3d48-b935-428b, pushed as Gerrit change 1050 off origin/main. Plan: land 1050 on main, then rebase this stack onto the new main so 1043 picks it up.'

findings.criterion: [operator-attested] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and the FULL gating suite (`make test`) pass, evidenced by the Gerrit change id and its `Verified +1` vote recorded in a comment on this ticket
findings.detail: The ticket comment recording the Verified +1 vote (commit 17a21ed21, change 1043) was written for patchset 1. A subsequent comment explicitly states that patchset 2 — the patchset that adds the new tests — received Verified -1 twice (deterministic, not a flake), due to a latent test-infra defect exposed by the changed xdist sharding. The comment records a plan to land a fix (bug 9f0b, change 1050) and rebase, but no follow-up attestation recording a Verified +1 on the rebased patchset appears in the ticket. The operator-attested criterion requires a concrete attestation naming the specific reference and observed outcome; the current evidence names a Verified +1 that predates the CI failure, and the most recent CI state on the current patchset is Verified -1.
findings.remediation: After landing change 1050 and rebasing change 1043, record a ticket comment naming the new patchset number, the Gerrit change URL (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1043), and the Verified +1 vote on that rebased patchset.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
